approvalScope: isolated implementation and tests only; no current app modifications, no main merge, no production deploy
featureFlagDefault: OFF; preview-only enabled by explicit LAB configuration
sourceOfTruth: createSavedPlacesService singleton per session/destination + future owner adapter

storage.guest: ephemeral session by default; explicit local persistence consent optional
storage.owner: port injected, write disabled by default; auth/csrf/capability/idempotency/readback required
storage.legacyMigration: explicit approval and unique canonical association required; no name-only automatic migration
